I estimate the arugula at about 60 g. It looks lightly dressed with oil, which adds roughly 40 kcal, so the salad comes to about 70 kcal.

The cauliflower is about 120 g. At around 25 kcal per 100 g that is about 30 kcal, and it may have a little butter or oil on it, which would bring it to about 50 kcal.

Together that is roughly 180 g of food and about 120 kcal. I'll allow a little extra for the dressing and round up to 130 kcal.
